missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Любопытство' is a neuter noun in the nominative case, acting as the subject of 'мучает'. The verb stays singular neuter to agree with it.

missions.phrase: Я не могу скрыть своё любопытство.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Любопытство' is the direct object of 'скрыть'. For neuter nouns the accusative matches the nominative, so the form does not change. 'Своё' agrees in neuter.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Любопытства' is the genitive form after 'от', expressing the cause of the action. The neuter ending -о shifts to -а in the genitive singular.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'полны'. 'Любопытства' is genitive because the short adjective 'полны' governs the genitive case. It is coordinated with 'энергии', also genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Любопытству' is the dative form required by 'благодаря', which expresses a positive cause. The neuter dative ending is -у.

missions.phrase: Он смотрел на нас с любопытством.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental of manner. 'Любопытством' is the instrumental form after 'с', describing how he looked. The neuter instrumental singular ends in -ом.

missions.phrase: В её любопытстве нет ничего плохого.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Любопытстве' is the prepositional form after 'в', naming the topic. The neuter prepositional singular ends in -е.
Strategic focus: Nominative with adjective. 'Любопытство' is nominative as the subject of 'помогает'. 'Детское' is the agreeing neuter adjective describing whose curiosity it is.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Любопытства' is the plural accusative direct object of 'изучают'. For inanimate neuter nouns the plural accusative equals the nominative plural in -а.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with adjective. 'Любопытство' is nominative as the subject of 'привело'. 'Простое' agrees in neuter, and the verb stands in the neuter past tense.
